levels.title: Level 1: The Red Planet
levels.intro: Three robots on and above Mars each left a mark. Open the right ones to find them.

clues.riddle: I was the first aircraft to fly on another world, and I was only meant to fly five times.
clues.hint: I hitched a ride on a rover that is hunting for signs of ancient life in Jezero Crater.
clues.found: Ingenuity flew 72 times and proved that powered flight works in Mars's thin air.

clues.riddle: I was built to last 90 days, but I kept rolling for more than 14 years. A dust storm finally ended my story.
clues.hint: I landed in Meridiani Planum in 2004 and my status is silent.
clues.found: Opportunity drove further than any other vehicle on another world.

clues.riddle: A sky crane lowered me into Gale Crater, where I found proof of an ancient lake.
clues.hint: I am still talking and still climbing Mount Sharp.
clues.found: Curiosity showed that Mars once had a lake with the ingredients for life.

levels.reward: Mars mapped! The next level takes you to the edge of the solar system.

levels.title: Level 2: Beyond the Planets
levels.intro: Far from the Sun, some of the oldest explorers still sail on. Find the travellers.

clues.riddle: I am the most distant human-made object, and I carry a golden record for anyone who finds me.
clues.hint: I launched in September 1977 and left the Sun's bubble in 2012.
clues.found: Voyager 1 is still sending data from interstellar space.

clues.riddle: My twin is more famous, but only I have ever visited both Uranus and Neptune.
clues.hint: I launched about two weeks before my twin.
clues.found: Voyager 2 flew past all four giant planets.

clues.riddle: I carry a metal plaque showing humans and a map to Earth, but my radio went quiet in 2003.
clues.hint: I was the first to cross the asteroid belt and to fly past Jupiter.
clues.found: Pioneer 10 is silent but still coasting through space.

levels.reward: Three travellers found. One last level: worlds with rings, ice and a footprint.

levels.title: Level 3: Rings, Ice and Footprints
levels.intro: The last clues cover Saturn, Pluto and the Moon. Find all three to win the treasure.

clues.riddle: After 13 years at Saturn I dived into it on purpose, to keep its moons clean.
clues.hint: Titan's lander Huygens rode with me.
clues.found: Cassini's Grand Finale protected moons that may be habitable.

clues.riddle: I was the first to fly past Pluto and photograph its heart-shaped plain.
clues.hint: I launched in 2006 and I am still talking, out in the Kuiper Belt.
clues.found: New Horizons also visited the snowman-shaped Arrokoth.

clues.riddle: Humans first stepped onto another world right here, in the Sea of Tranquility.
clues.hint: Look near the Moon, close to Earth.
clues.found: On 20 July 1969, Armstrong and Aldrin walked here.

levels.reward: You found the treasure: you have now met all the explorers that went furthest, flew first, or lasted longest.
